sloka: यदि चोद्योजयिष्यामि भर्तारं रामकारणात् ।व्यर्थमागमनं तस्य ससैन्यस्य भविष्यति ।। ५.३०.१५।।।।
transliteration: yadi codyojayiṣyāmi bhartāraṁ rāmakāraṇāt ।vyarthamāgamanaṁ tasya sasainyasya bhaviṣyati ।। 5.30.15।।।।

translations.english: "If I get the lord of vanaras and his army for the cause of Rama (without talking to Sita), their arrival will be useless (if Sita would have given up her life by then).
